about_the_game:
The world's most realistic esports management game.

Hire your staff, trade for star players, and even set the price of hot dogs—you're in complete control!

Take charge of the worst team in the league and guide them to glory, or defend the title with reigning champions. Play through an entire season packed with preseason, splits, playoffs, international competitions, and a fully immersive offseason complete with free agency, retirements, and more.

How you build your team is entirely up to you. Do you have what it takes to win it all?

Game Features

  • In-depth Players: Scout and sign players with diverse stats and attributes, crafting the perfect roster to match your playstyle and team synergy.

  • Day-to-Day Decisions: Balance player rest and training intensity, analyze gameplay footage, or encourage team bonding—every decision affects performance.

  • Long-term Strategy: Face tough choices like going into debt to keep your stars, or rebuilding from the ground up after a disappointing season.

  • Full GM/Owner Control: Set ticket and merchandise prices, hire or fire your entire staff—from coaches and analysts to cooks—and trade players to assemble the ultimate dream team.

  • Infinite Replayability: Choose from 16 unique teams and play through unlimited seasons, navigating random events, unexpected injuries, and even social media scandals.

Are you ready to become the GOAT of esports management? Prove it in Esports Team Manager!
